name: iris_database_list (extension)
description: Existing tool extended with free space fields per database entry.

new_fields_per_entry.size_mb: integer|null — database size in MB (SizeInt column)
new_fields_per_entry.free_space_mb: float|null — available space in MB (AvailableNum column)
new_fields_per_entry.max_size_mb: integer|null — configured max size in MB; null if Unlimited
new_fields_per_entry.free_pct: integer|null — used space as percentage 0-100 (Free column)

root_degradation_field.free_space_note: string — present only when %SYS.DatabaseQuery:FreeSpace query failed; explains why free space fields are absent

notes: Existing fields unchanged — no breaking change
free_space fields absent per-entry (not null) when graceful degradation active
Requires %SYS namespace access; degrades gracefully if unavailable
